name: Rich — plenty of experience, barely flying this year
summary: Over 200 hours with 60-odd thermic, and he can still fly — good kiting, reliable launches, centres a climb, reads a day. But a new job means under 10 hours in the last 12 months and less than one flight a month lately. He wants to get back into cross-country and thinks a better wing is part of that.
why_this_persona: The pilot the 'occasional_pilot_profile' gate exists for, and the only step on the ladder where currency alone can cap a result above the no-flying-at-all line. Three separate manufacturer voices say their high-B wings are not for occasional pilots and want pilots who are very current, which is the broadest non-numeric agreement at this boundary. He is also the proof that the gate is about currency rather than ability: nothing in his skills answers is weak.

notes: Computed skills 71.3, psychological 78.8, total 74.6, no bonus. His total sits in the Nearly ready band, so the Not yet comes entirely from the gate — gates override the total, which is the point of them.

EXACTLY ONE GATE. 'occasional_pilot_profile' requires BOTH flying_frequency: less_than_monthly AND airtime_last_12m in [under_10, 10_25]. He has both. A scorer that fires it on the frequency answer alone would wrongly cap a current pilot in a seasonal lull, which is the specific failure the combination exists to prevent — worth a synthetic unit check that the same pilot with airtime_last_12m: 50_80 is NOT gated.
'no_recent_flying' must NOT fire: that gate needs 'none_3m', and he has flown, just rarely. 'recurrency_plan' must not fire for the same reason — it is the comeback-from-nothing suggestion.

Both thermic gates must NOT fire: he has 50-100 thermic hours, comfortably past the figure. This persona and persona 03 are a useful pair — 03 has the hours habit but not the thermic hours, 04 has the thermic hours but not the habit, and both land short. The two measures are deliberately independent, per knowledge/disagreements.md point 2.
'test_fly_first' must not fire on a Not yet result; its trigger is ready or nearly_ready only.

'equipment_as_a_fix_with_thin_readiness' must NOT fire: his motive is wanting more performance, which is deliberately absent from that gate's motive list per knowledge/disagreements.md point 9, and his wing_expectation is the accurate one.

Three displayed-suggestion slots are doing real work here — improve_currency displaces the always-on 'stay_current_whatever_you_decide' on the shared 'currency' topic, which is the dedupe behaviour config/suggestions/mid-b-to-high-b.json's sizing_check describes. The displayed count must still land between 3 and 5.
